points.title: 出家修行
points.description: 鉴真出生于扬州，14岁时在扬州大云寺出家，师从道岸律师。他勤奋好学，精通佛学经典，尤其擅长戒律研究。20岁时受具足戒，后游历长安、洛阳等地，向多位高僧学习佛法。这一时期奠定了他深厚的佛学基础和戒律专长，为他日后东渡日本传播戒律奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Yangzhou, Jianzhen became a monk at Daxiang Temple at age 14 under the guidance of Master Dao'an. He studied diligently, mastering Buddhist scriptures and specializing in Vinaya (monastic discipline). At 20, he received full monastic precepts and traveled to Chang'an and Luoyang to study under various eminent monks. This period established his profound Buddhist knowledge and expertise in monastic discipline, laying the foundation for his later journey to Japan to spread the Vinaya.

points.title: 研习戒律
points.description: 鉴真前往当时的政治文化中心长安，在长安实际寺、西明寺等著名寺院研习佛法。他师从多位高僧，深入学习了南山律宗的戒律体系，成为当时著名的律学大师。在此期间，他不仅自己研习佛法，还培养了众多弟子，为佛教戒律的传承和发展做出了重要贡献。这一时期的学习使他在佛学界的声望日益提高，也为他日后接受日本僧人邀请埋下伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: Jianzhen traveled to Chang'an, the political and cultural capital, studying at renowned monasteries like Shisi Temple and Ximing Temple. He learned from multiple masters, deeply studying the Vinaya system of the Nanshan School, becoming a renowned master of monastic discipline. During this time, he not only studied Buddhism himself but also cultivated numerous disciples, making significant contributions to the transmission and development of Buddhist monastic rules. His reputation grew, laying the groundwork for his later invitation to Japan.

points.title: 东渡准备
points.description: 742年，日本僧人荣睿、普照等人来到扬州，恳请鉴真东渡日本传授戒律。鉴真欣然应允，开始筹备东渡事宜。他在扬州组织僧团，准备经卷、佛像等物品，并建造船只。然而，前五次东渡均遭遇挫折：第一次因同行的日本僧人被官府怀疑而失败；第二次遭遇风暴，船只破损；第三次被官府阻止；第四次在海上遭遇风暴，漂流至海南岛；第五次因鉴真眼疾加重而失败。这些挫折使鉴真双目失明，但他东渡弘法的决心从未动摇。
points.descriptionEn: In 742, Japanese monks Erei and Fusho arrived in Yangzhou, inviting Jianzhen to Japan to transmit the Vinaya. Jianzhen readily agreed and began preparations. He organized a monastic community, prepared scriptures, Buddha statues, and built ships. However, the first five attempts all failed: the first was thwarted when Japanese companions were suspected by authorities; the second ship was damaged in a storm; the third was stopped by officials; the fourth encountered storms and drifted to Hainan Island; the fifth failed as Jianzhen's eye condition worsened. These setbacks left Jianzhen blind, but his determination to propagate Buddhism in Japan never wavered.

points.title: 第六次东渡
points.description: 748年，鉴真从扬州出发，开始第六次东渡。途中遭遇台风，漂流至海南岛，后辗转返回大陆。751年，鉴真再次尝试东渡，但被官府阻止。753年，鉴真趁日本遣唐使团回国之际，秘密搭乘遣唐使船队，终于成功东渡。这次航行历时两个多月，鉴真虽已双目失明，但凭借对佛法的坚定信念和丰富经验，带领弟子们克服重重困难，最终抵达日本。这次成功标志着鉴真东渡弘法事业的重大突破。
points.descriptionEn: In 748, Jianzhen began his sixth journey from Yangzhou. En route, they encountered a typhoon and drifted to Hainan Island, later returning to the mainland. In 751, another attempt was thwarted by authorities. In 753, seizing the opportunity of a Japanese envoy's return, Jianzhen secretly boarded their ship and finally succeeded in reaching Japan. The voyage lasted over two months. Despite being blind, Jianzhen's firm faith in Buddhism and extensive experience helped him and his disciples overcome numerous difficulties, marking a major breakthrough in his mission to propagate Buddhism in Japan.

points.title: 日本弘法
points.description: 754年，鉴真抵达日本奈良，受到日本朝廷和僧众的热烈欢迎。他在东大寺设立戒坛，为圣武天皇、皇太后等400余人授戒，正式确立了日本佛教的戒律制度。鉴真还创建了唐招提寺，作为日本律宗的中心。他不仅传授戒律，还带来了大量中国文物、典籍、艺术品，对日本文化产生了深远影响。鉴真还精通医学，在日本行医治病，传授中药知识。763年，鉴真在日本圆寂，享年76岁。他的弟子们继承了他的事业，使鉴真开创的日本律宗得以延续和发展。
points.descriptionEn: In 754, Jianzhen arrived in Nara, Japan, receiving a warm welcome from the imperial court and monks. He established a platform for precepts at Todai Temple, granting monastic precepts to over 400 people including Emperor Shomu and Empress Komyo, formally establishing the monastic discipline system in Japanese Buddhism. Jianzhen also founded Toshodai-ji Temple, becoming the center of Japanese Vinaya Buddhism. He not only transmitted monastic discipline but also brought numerous Chinese cultural artifacts, classics, and artworks, profoundly influencing Japanese culture. Jianzhen was also skilled in medicine, practicing medicine and teaching Chinese herbal knowledge in Japan. In 763, Jianzhen passed away in Japan at the age of 76. His disciples continued his work, ensuring the perpetuation and development of the Japanese Vinaya school he founded.

supporter.zh: 鉴真被视为中日文化交流的伟大使者和不畏艰难的佛教传播者。他六次东渡，历经磨难，双目失明仍坚持东渡弘法的精神，体现了佛教徒的坚定信念和无私奉献。鉴真不仅为日本佛教建立了完整的戒律制度，还带来了中国先进的文化、艺术、医学知识，极大地促进了日本文化的发展。他的贡献超越了宗教领域，成为中日友好交流的历史象征。
supporter.en: Jianzhen is revered as a great messenger of Sino-Japanese cultural exchange and an indomitable propagator of Buddhism. His six attempts to cross the sea to Japan, enduring hardships and continuing despite blindness, embody the unwavering faith and selfless dedication of a Buddhist practitioner. Jianzhen not only established a complete monastic discipline system in Japanese Buddhism but also brought advanced Chinese culture, art, and medical knowledge, significantly promoting Japanese cultural development. His contributions transcend the religious realm, becoming a historical symbol of Sino-Japanese friendship and exchange.

critic.zh: 从现代视角看，鉴真东渡也存在一些争议。首先，他东渡过程中多次违反当时唐朝的海禁政策，可能被视为对国家法律的挑战。其次，鉴真将中国佛教戒律强加于日本佛教，某种程度上限制了日本佛教本土化的发展。此外，鉴真对日本佛教的影响也导致了日本与中国在佛教传统上的某些分歧，这些分歧在后世有时成为两国关系中的敏感因素。
critic.en: From a modern perspective, Jianzhen's journey to Japan also has some controversies. First, he repeatedly violated the maritime ban policies of the Tang Dynasty during his attempts to cross to Japan, which could be seen as challenging national laws. Second, by imposing Chinese Buddhist monastic discipline on Japanese Buddhism, Jianzhen to some extent restricted the indigenous development of Japanese Buddhism. Additionally, Jianzhen's influence on Japanese Buddhism led to certain divergences in Buddhist traditions between China and Japan, which later sometimes became sensitive factors in bilateral relations.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，鉴真被公认为中日文化交流史上的重要人物。他的东渡不仅传播了佛教戒律，更是一次大规模的文化输出，将唐朝的先进文化、艺术、建筑、医学等传入日本，对日本奈良时代的文化发展产生了深远影响。在流行文化中，鉴真常被塑造成不畏艰难、坚持理想的象征，其精神激励着后人。鉴真的故事也体现了古代中日两国在宗教、文化上的密切联系，是东亚文化交流史上的重要篇章。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Jianzhen is widely recognized as a significant figure in the history of Sino-Japanese cultural exchange. His journey not only transmitted Buddhist monastic discipline but also represented a large-scale cultural export, introducing Tang Dynasty's advanced culture, art, architecture, medicine, and more to Japan, profoundly influencing the cultural development of Japan's Nara period. In popular culture, Jianzhen is often portrayed as a symbol of perseverance and unwavering ideals, inspiring later generations. His story reflects the close religious and cultural connections between ancient China and Japan, representing an important chapter in the history of East Asian cultural exchange.

self.zh: 我此身若能东渡日本，传戒律于彼国，虽死无憾。
self.en: If I can cross to Japan and transmit the monastic discipline to that country, I will have no regrets even in death.

others.zh: 鉴真和尚东渡日本，不仅传播了佛教戒律，更带去了大唐的文化精髓，是中日文化交流史上不可磨灭的一页。
others.en: Master Jianzhen's journey to Japan not only transmitted Buddhist monastic discipline but also brought the essence of Tang Dynasty culture, leaving an indelible mark in the history of Sino-Japanese cultural exchange.
